about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Who I am
bioParagraphs: I work where operations, systems and data meet, which is where most operational problems actually start. At Bullboat, a UK-based partner helping consumer brands grow across Europe's leading retailers, my job is to make sure the business runs on reliable information.

I owned the data migration from Sage to Cin7, integrated our systems with warehouse partners in the Netherlands and the UK, and replaced manual reporting with automated workflows and Power BI dashboards. Today I'm leading our move to Microsoft Azure and building the data platform behind our reporting.

In practice, that means tracing data from source to report: checking records after a migration, reconciling reports against the systems they come from, and fixing issues where they start rather than where they show up.

pipeline.title: How I build a data pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Real case: from the Cin7 API to Power BI
pipeline.description: This is the system I built at Bullboat. A single generic pipeline in Azure Data Factory brings each Cin7 entity into Azure SQL and leaves the tables ready for Power BI.

nodes.label: Cin7 Core API
nodes.description: Products, customers, suppliers and sales come from here. I only pull what has changed since the last load.

nodes.label: Azure Data Factory
nodes.description: An orchestrator reads a config table and runs the same pipeline for every entity. Adding a new entity means adding a row, not building a new pipeline.
specs: Watermark so nothing is reloaded twice

nodes.label: Azure SQL
nodes.description: Every entity goes through three layers: the raw JSON, a clean table, and the final table, updated with MERGE.

nodes.label: Power BI & automations
nodes.description: The final tables feed a star-schema model in Power BI and the stock reports sent to clients, retailers and marketplaces.
specs: Stock reports by email and SFTP

roles.summary: Own the transition to Microsoft Azure and the data platform behind the company's reporting, connecting Cin7 Core, warehouse partners, retailers and marketplaces.
highlights: Designing a data warehouse in Azure SQL with generic, incremental Data Factory pipelines that load multiple Cin7 API endpoints into analysis-ready tables for Power BI.

Built a read-only MCP server in Python (FastMCP) that exposes the Cin7 Core API to Claude, giving the team AI-assisted access to orders, stock, purchasing and customer data through a single governed API connection.
Owned the end-to-end data migration from Sage to Cin7 Core: extraction, transformation into Cin7 templates, and verification of data accuracy and integrity.
Own automated stock reporting for NL and UK clients, delivered by email (Power Automate, Office Scripts) and by SFTP/FTPS to retailers and marketplaces, driven by a control table in Azure SQL.
Build Power BI semantic models (DAX) for KPIs, stock and order flow, and coordinate dropship order management with warehouse operations, translating operational needs into system requirements.

roles.summary: End-to-end exposure to logistics operations across UK and Netherlands warehouses, progressively taking ownership of data quality, reporting and automation.
highlights: Managed international order tracking and stock control across NL and UK fulfilment centres, following each order from warehouse to customer delivery.
Administered logistics databases, ensuring data integrity, traceability and consistency.
Built automation scripts and reporting tools that reduced manual workload, laying the groundwork for the process-improvement work that followed.
Contributed to the design of data models for operational Business Intelligence, improving customer-service visibility.

roles.summary: Supported global supply chain operations with analysis of national, international and e-commerce order data.
highlights: Analysed national, international and e-commerce order data to improve order-management efficiency and KPI compliance.
Managed and tracked international orders, including stock control by product line.
Prepared weekly operational reports, including Intrastat reporting for intra-EU trade.

roles.summary: Installation and maintenance technician for telecommunications infrastructure, working with contractors including Ezentis, Atelco and Vimantik.
highlights: Installed and maintained FTTH and RJ45 networks in residential buildings and public facilities.
Additional responsibilities in transport, logistics and occupational risk prevention.

items.title: MCP server for Cin7
items.subtitle: Claude querying the ERP, read-only
items.description: A Python MCP server that lets Claude query the Cin7 Core API: orders, stock, purchasing and customers, all through one controlled connection.
items.caseStudy: Day to day, the team asks things like how much stock is left or where an order is. With this server, Claude can answer by querying Cin7 directly, with no write access and no manual exports.
highlights: Tools for orders, stock, purchasing and customers
Read-only by design
Packaged with Docker for easy deployment

items.title: Credit card fraud detection
items.subtitle: Machine learning project in progress
items.description: Working with Kaggle's Credit Card Fraud dataset, split into three parts: exploratory analysis, preprocessing and modelling.
items.caseStudy: Fraud is a tiny share of the transactions and most features come from a PCA, so the real challenge is understanding the data before modelling. The first model trains on every feature and I improve it from there.
highlights: Duplicates removed before the train/test split
Skewness and kurtosis of Time and Amount
Mutual information to catch non-linear relationships

items.title: Cuadra
items.subtitle: Invoicing and accounting SaaS
items.description: My own project: an invoicing and accounting tool for freelancers, accounting firms and small businesses, with an AI assistant and Cuadri as its mascot.
items.caseStudy: The idea is to make invoicing and bookkeeping simple for people who aren't accountants, with an assistant that guides you through it.
highlights: Built for freelancers, accounting firms and SMEs
Built-in AI assistant
Website and promo video in progress

items.title: Cin7 to Azure SQL pipeline
items.subtitle: Real Bullboat case (anonymised)
items.description: An ingestion system in Azure Data Factory that brings products, customers, suppliers and sales from the Cin7 API into Azure SQL to feed Power BI.
items.caseStudy: Every report used to depend on manual exports. Now an orchestrator reads a config table and loads only what has changed. Sales, which carry lines, shipments and invoices, are stored in seven related tables so Power BI can use them without duplicating data.
highlights: Incremental load with a watermark
Landing, staging and core layers with MERGE
Star schema ready for Power BI

chapters.title: Hi, I'm Juan Andrés.
chapters.text: I'm the Business Systems Analyst at Bullboat, and my job is making company data reliable, from the ERP all the way to the report. Here's my story in a minute, no scrolling.

chapters.title: I started with my hands on the cables
chapters.text: While starting Business Administration and Data Science at ESIC, I worked as a network technician installing fibre (FTTH) and RJ45 cabling in buildings and public facilities.

chapters.title: From cables to data
chapters.text: At Zamora Company, as a Global Supply Chain Intern, I analysed national, international and e-commerce orders in SAP, tracked stock by product line and put together the weekly reports, Intrastat included.

chapters.title: From Madrid to Tallinn
chapters.text: A semester of international business at Estonian Business School, 2,893 km from home.

chapters.title: Making the business run on reliable data
chapters.text: I joined as a Logistics & Operations Intern and today I'm the Business Systems Analyst. I migrated our data from Sage to Cin7, connected the warehouses in the Netherlands and the UK, and now I'm leading our move to Microsoft Azure.

chapters.title: AI connected to the business
chapters.text: I built an MCP server in Python so Claude can query Cin7 (orders, stock, purchasing and customers) with read-only access. And this site's assistant answers questions about me using RAG and Gemini.

chapters.title: Business and data, at the same time
chapters.text: Two highest-distinction awards at ESIC, the Azure AI Fundamentals certification, native Spanish and B2 English. What I do best is understanding what operations need and turning it into a system that works.

chapters.title: Shall we talk?
chapters.text: Ask my assistant anything, download my CV or reach me on LinkedIn.
